<ol class="process"><li><b>Bring the work</b><span>Choose a decision, document or hand-off whose reasoning can be inspected.</span></li><li><b>Expose the habit</b><span>Record an initial response before discussing it with others.</span></li><li><b>Set the constraint</b><span>Name purpose, evidence requirements and a stopping rule.</span></li><li><b>Make a decision</b><span>Select, reject or escalate; explain why.</span></li><li><b>Submit to critique</b><span>Let a colleague challenge the evidence and assumptions.</span></li><li><b>Return to practice</b><span>Revise the working tool and test it on another task.</span></li></ol>
